newsitem.title: THAILAND: Dusit Thani to sell 25 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Dusit Thani to sell 25 mln new shares.

text.p: Hotel operator Dusit Thani Plc said on Tuesday it will raise its capital to 850 million baht ($34 million) from 600 million by floating 25 million new shares.
The new shares will be offered by private placement to Goldman Sachs or its affiliates at 30 baht each or a total of 750 million baht, Dusit Thani said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
Dusit Thani said proceeds from the share issue would be used for repaying debts incurred from its investment in Philippine Hoteliers Inc and Dusit Sinthorn Co Ltd.
Dusit Thani said it had earlier paid 595 million baht with foreign debt financing to acquire 3.52 million shares, or a 85.76 percent stake, in Philippine Hoteliers.
Dusit Thani also bought a 50 percent interest in Dusit Sinthorn Co Ltd for a total of 1.1 billion baht, of which 239 million baht was funded by offshore borrowing.
